olivia_sales: Quick question from the ACME POC — they want to confirm we can do customer-managed keys (BYOK) with an HSM-backed KMS. They also asked about demo steps for the POC and how key rotation is handled. Any short answers I can share in the next call?

jamal_se: TL;DR: yes for cloud KMS BYOK (AWS/GCP/Azure) + support for external HSM via PKCS#11 integration in Private. Need to clarify standard turnaround for attestation docs.

sasha_security: Correct. For Hosted API we integrate with customer KMS via envelope encryption patterns (we never store plaintext). For Private/VPC we can integrate with customer HSM using a PKCS#11 bridge or our HSM connector. We can provide CAIQ snippets for these controls.

olivia_sales: Can you give me a one-paragraph I can paste into the SOW about rotation policy, and an example config or command I can share with their infra team?

ben_engineering: Paste this for SOW: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys using envelope encryption. Data keys are generated and encrypted (wrapped) by the customer's KMS; only ciphertext is stored in Redwood. We support automatic key rotation orchestrated by the customer's KMS and recommend rotation frequency of 90 days for high-sensitivity workloads. For Private deployments, an on-prem HSM can be connected via PKCS#11 bridge; Redwood validates connectivity and audit logs during onboarding."

ben_engineering: Example config (Private deployment PKCS#11):
```
kms.provider: pkcs11
pkcs11.module_path: /opt/hsm/lib/libhsm.so
pkcs11.slot: 1
key_label: redwood-data-key
wrapping: kms-enveloping
```

sasha_security: Add this about attestations: "We can produce KMS-related technical evidence: key usage logs, KMS access IAM roles, HSM connection logs, and signing certificates. For cloud KMS we provide configuration screenshots and policy docs; for on-prem HSM we provide connectivity test results and PKI cert chains where available."

olivia_sales: Do we have a standard answer for whether Redwood holds any unencrypted copy of customer keys? They want a sentence for procurement.

sasha_security: Short answer: we do NOT hold unencrypted customer master keys. Only wrapped data keys (ciphertext) are stored. Customer-controlled KMS/HSM holds the master keys.

jamal_se: Pricing note for POC: BYOK / Private HSM onboarding has an onboarding engineering fee + optional quarterly attestation package. I'll DM Finance for exact numbers to include in the quote.

olivia_sales: Awesome. Last: can security ops request periodic key rotation tests as part of the POC?

ben_engineering: Yes — we can run a rotation dry-run during POC. Steps: 1) provision test CMK in customer's KMS 2) configure Redwood to use test CMK 3) trigger rotation via KMS 4) verify token/db access and KV cache invalidation. Expect ~2-4 hours for a single dry-run with on-prem HSM connectivity checks.

sasha_security: I'll attach a CAIQ snippet after the call with precise control IDs for encryption (e.g., SC-8, SC-13 style mapping). security-bot: generated artifact ready: https://internal.redwood.corp/attestations/acme-poc-kms-reqs.pdf :white_check_mark:

olivia_sales: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll forward these bits in the call notes and add the config sample to the SOW. :thumbsup:
